description: Work with Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT: find, add and update constituents, record gifts, log actions and notes, and start workflows when constituents, gifts or actions are added or changed.

blackbaud_action_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an action is changed in Raiser's Edge NXT, such as marked completed. Checks every 10 minutes.

output.category: Phone Call, Meeting, Mailing, Email or Task/Other
output.date_added: When the action was added, in ISO 8601
output.date_modified: When the action was last changed, in ISO 8601
output.type: The action type from your Actions table

blackbaud_constituent_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a constituent's record is changed in Raiser's Edge NXT, with what it holds now. Checks every 10 minutes.

output.birthdate: A date that may be partial
output.date_added: When the record was added, in ISO 8601
output.date_modified: When the record was last changed, in ISO 8601
output.fundraiser_status: Fundraiser status: Active, Inactive or None
output.lookup_id: The constituent's lookup id, chosen by your organization
output.name: The full name
output.title: Title, such as Dr.

blackbaud_gift_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a gift is changed in Raiser's Edge NXT, such as posted or acknowledged, to any fund or the one you choose. Checks every 10 minutes.

output.constituency: The constituency the gift counts towards
output.date_added: When the gift was added, in ISO 8601
output.date_modified: When the gift was last changed, in ISO 8601
output.gift_splits: How the gift is split between funds
output.gift_status: Active, Held, Terminated, Completed or Cancelled
output.post_date: When it was posted to the general ledger
output.type: The gift type, such as Donation or Pledge

parameters.description: Only gifts to this fund. Leave blank for every fund.
parameters.name: fund_id
